lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in a dense, semi-stochastic cluster posterior to the gills, transitioning into more defined horizontal rows along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical high-intensity bands intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient featuring high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and low-luminance shadow pixels on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, dark, circular protrusion with irregular surface texture is visible on the ventro-lateral surface, posterior to the branchial region and near the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple remoras attached to the ventral posterior region and a school of small yellow-and-silver fish clustered around the anterior and pectoral areas.
